blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent studies report that video diffusion models "know more than they show": physical properties decode better from their activations than from their inputs or outputs. But a diffusion model computes its clean-sample estimate from those same activations, so such a comparison measures how easily a readout extracts the information. Whether the model hides anything is a separate question. We set out to find hidden physical knowledge in kinematic text-to-motion diffusion models, where the physics of every intermediate estimate can be computed exactly, and recorded every layer along the sampling trajectories of MDM (two checkpoints) and MotionDiffuse. Against the usual baselines the layers do look ahead of the model's own estimate on balance and flight. With every readout tuned the same way, the estimate closes the gap: for balance and flight, adding a layer gains at most 0.01, a size that a positive control shows we would detect. The fall rate of jumps is the one clear exception. Early in denoising, MDM's layers add about 0.08 in $R^2$ (up to 0.11 in a refit) that the estimate does not yet show, and the gain fades as sampling proceeds; on MotionDiffuse it is small and not robust. The estimate also flags floating samples without training, but aborting them saves under a tenth of the compute. In a video model, plausibility that linear probes miss in Wan 2.1's clean latent becomes readable after one fixed nonlinearity.
blocks.zh: 近期的研究表明,视频传播模型"知道多于显示":物理属性解码比其激活比其输入或输出更好. 但是,一个扩散模型会从这些相同的激活中计算出它的清洁样本估计值,所以这样的比较测量读出如何容易提取信息. 模型是否隐藏任何东西是一个单独的问题. 我们开始寻找动态文字到运动传播模型中隐藏的物理知识,可以准确计算每个中间估计的物理,并沿着MDM(两个检查站)和MotionDiffuse的取样轨迹记录每一层。 与通常的基线相比,各层确实比模型本身对平衡和飞行的估计更早。 每一个读出都以同样的方式调制, 估计会缩小差距: 对于平衡和飞行, 增加一层增益,最多0.01, 这个尺寸是正控显示我们会发现的。 跳跃的下降率是一个明显的例外. 早期的去诺化,MDM的分层以$R^2美元(在重置中最多为0.11)增加约0.08,估计值尚未显示,收益随着采样过程而逐渐消退;在MotionDiffuse上则小而不坚固. 估计中也标注了未经过训练的浮标样本,但中止它们会省下计算结果的十分之一. 在视频模型中,线性探测器在Wan 2.1的清洁潜伏中缺失的可信性在固定的非线性之后变得可以读取.

blocks.en: Text-to-motion models turn a sentence into seconds of fluent human movement ( Guo et al., 2022 ; Tevet et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Guo et al., 2024 ; Rempe et al., 2026 ) . Most are kinematic. They output joint positions and rotations directly, with no simulator, so whatever physics they produce is learned from motion capture and never enforced. Physics-based generators instead move a simulated character, so gravity and contact hold by construction ( Peng et al., 2018 ; Tessler et al., 2024 ) . Kinematic models’ most visible failures are therefore physical: bodies hover above the ground, feet slide while planted, and jumps do not fall as they should. Most remedies act from outside the generator. They project samples through a physics simulator ( Yuan et al., 2023 ) , condition on physical parameters ( Watanabe et al., 2025 ) , model contact and body forces explicitly ( Xing et al., 2026 ) , or optimize the sampling noise ( Stölzle et al., 2026 ) . Whether the generator itself represents the physics it gets wrong is a separate and useful question: if the physics is present inside the model but lost on the way out, the internal signal could flag failing samples before compute is spent finishing them.
blocks.zh: 文字到运动模型将句子转换为流畅的人类运动秒(郭等,2022;特维特等,2023;张等,2023;郭等,2024;伦培等,2026. 多数是动能 它们直接输出联合位置并进行旋转,没有模拟器,所以它们生产的任何物理都从运动捕捉学来,从不执行. 基于物理的发电机转而移动一个模拟的特性,因此重力和接触被构造所牵制(Peng等,2018;Tessler等,2024. 因此,动能模型最明显的故障是物理上的:身体在地上徘徊,脚在被植入时会滑倒,跳跃不会像他们应该的那样下降。 大多数补救都来自生成者之外。 他们通过物理模拟器(Yuan等,2023年),物理参数条件(Watanabe等,2025年),模型接触力和体力明确(Xing等,2026年),或优化取样噪音(Stölzle等,2026年)来投放样本. 生成器本身是否代表它得到的物理,是一个单独而有用的问题:如果物理在模型内部存在,但在出道时丢失了,内部信号可能在计算完成之前标出失败的样本.

blocks.en: For video diffusion models, recent work answers yes. Physical quantities are linearly decodable from transformer activations and are reported to be built inside the model rather than inherited from its input ( Kneifl et al., 2026 ) . Plausibility is decodable from the internal states of models whose outputs violate physics, a finding its authors summarize as models that “know more than they show” ( Esmati et al., 2026 ) . Probes on denoising features are used to prune implausible samples early ( Tang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 对于视频传播模型,最近的工作回答是的. 物理量可线性地从变压器活化中解码出,并报告在模型内部建造,而不是从其输入中继承(Kneifl等,2026年). 从其输出违反物理的模型内部状态中,可解码,其作者将这种模型总结为“了解多于显示”(Esmati等,2026年)。 关于去诺化特征的探測被用来早期prune不可信的样品(Tang等,2026.).

blocks.en: These conclusions rest on a comparison between a probe on internal activations and a readout of what the model takes in or puts out. In a diffusion model, the estimate of the clean sample at each step is computed from the activations at that step together with the noisy input (and, in MotionDiffuse, the text), so it cannot carry information about the outcome that they lack (Section 3.3 ). A probe that beats a readout of the estimate shows only that the information is easier for that probe to use in the activations ( Xu et al., 2020 ) . The output may still contain all of it. How much such a gap means depends on three things: whether the two readouts are equally flexible and equally well tuned; whether the gap holds within a prompt, or only reflects which prompt was given; and whether there was enough training data for the comparison to be stable.
blocks.zh: 这些结论所依据的是内部活化探测器与该模型的输入或输出内容的读出之间的比较。 在扩散模型中,每个步骤对清洁样品的估计都是从该步骤的活化量和噪音输入(在MotionDiffuse中,文本)一起计算的,因此它不能包含关于它们缺乏的结果的信息(第3.3节)。 超过估计值的探测器只显示,该探测器在活化过程中更容易使用(Xu等人,2020年)。 输出可能仍然包含全部. 这种差距意味着什么,取决于三件事:两种读取是否同样灵活,是否同样调整良好;差距是否在即时存在,还是仅反映给出了何种即时;以及是否有足够的培训数据使比较保持稳定。

blocks.en: We set out to show that a motion diffusion model, too, knows more than it shows, and to use that knowledge to stop failing samples early. Text-to-motion diffusion suits the test, because all three conditions can be checked: the physics of a motion follows exactly from its joint positions, the models we study expose a clean-motion estimate at every step (MDM predicts it, Tevet et al., 2023 ; MotionDiffuse computes it from its noise prediction, Zhang et al., 2022 ), and sampling is cheap enough to record thousands of complete trajectories. We record every transformer layer along each model’s own sampling path, for 6,000 motions from 250 prompts with two MDM checkpoints and 3,000 with MotionDiffuse, and compute dynamic balance (the extrapolated center of mass relative to the area of foot support; Hof et al., 2005 ), flight, gravity during flight, and floating from the final motions. Two choices were made along the way. We added a set of jump-heavy prompts once it was clear that the main prompts contain too few falling bodies to test gravity, and we redefined “airborne” after finding that the first definition counted hovering and crawling as flight (Appendix C ). The result is not the one we set out to show.
blocks.zh: 我们开始显示一个运动传播模型 所知道的比它所显示的要多, 并且利用这个知识来阻止早期的样本失败。 文本到运动传播适合测试,因为可以检查所有三个条件:一个运动的物理完全遵循其联想位置,我们研究的模型暴露出每个步骤的清洁运动估计(MDM预测它,Tevet等,2023;MotionDiffuse从它的噪声预测中计算出它,张等,2022),采样成本低到可以记录上千个完整的轨迹. 我们记录每个模型本身的取样路径上的每个变压器层,从250个导出6000个运动,有两个MDM检查站,还有3000个MotionDiffuse,并计算动态平衡(相对于足部支持面积的推断质量中心;Hof等人,2005年),飞行,飞行中的重力,以及从最后运动中漂出. 沿途作出了两项选择。 一旦发现主要提示中包含的坠落体太少而无法测试地心引力,我们便添加了一套跳跃-重力提示,我们发现第一个定义将徘徊和爬行算作飞行(附录C)后重新定义了"空降". 结果不是我们要展示的

blocks.en: • Physics is readable early. A fifth of the way through denoising, linear probes on the layers already recover the final motion’s dynamic balance and flight ( R 2 = 0.84 R^{2}=0.84 and AUC 0.97 on the 50-step model), stably across seeds and on held-out prompts (Section 4.2 ). • The apparent hidden knowledge is a readout effect. Standard baselines make the layers look better informed than the estimate. Read with equal care, the estimate matches them. For balance and flight, on all three models, adding a layer gains at most 0.01, and a positive control shows that the protocol would detect a gain of that size. Floating behaves the same on the jump prompts; only in the smaller main data sets does the layer help (Section 4.3 ). With too little training data the comparison can flip, which explains a pilot study that pointed the other way (Section 4.4 ). • One exception, and it fades. Only for the fall rate of jumps do the layers know more. A fifth of the way through denoising, MDM’s layers add about 0.08 in R 2 R^{2} (up to 0.11 in a refit) to the best readout of the estimate, and on the 50-step model the gain survives every control we applied. It fades as sampling proceeds and the estimate catches up. On MotionDiffuse the same gain is small and not robust (Section 4.3 ). • The output is enough for early warning. Decoded partway through sampling, MDM’s own estimate flags samples that will float, without training and about as well as a trained probe on the layers. Aborting them saves under a tenth of the compute, because floating affects only 9 to 18% of samples and concentrates in a few prompts (Section 4.5 ). • A related issue in video. A linear probe at chance is the main evidence that plausibility is absent from the clean VAE latent of a video diffusion model ( Esmati et al., 2026 ) . One fixed, training-free nonlinearity, the size of local frame-to-frame change, makes it readable from the same latent: a linear readout of it reaches 78% pairwise accuracy on IntPhys, and 80% together with the grid features (Section 4.6 ). • What actually fails. Once bodies that hover without falling are separated out, MDM’s jumps fall at close to the right rate in the median. The common failure is floating, and on test captions the original 1000-step checkpoint floats about twice as often as the 50-step one (Section 4.1 ). Section 5 turns these findings into five checks for probing studies that claim a generator knows more than it shows.

MDM的分层在R 2 R^{2}中增加了大约0.08个(在重置中最多为0.11个), 它随着采样的进行而消退,估计也赶上了。 • 关于动议,同样的收益很小,不是很强(第4.3节)。 产出足以进行预警。 MDM自己估计会浮出水面的旗帜样本, 中止它们节省了计算值的十分之一,因为漂浮只影响9%至18%的样品,在少数情况下会浓缩(第4.5节)。 视频中的相关议题. 偶然的线性探测器是视频传播模型(Esmati等,2026年)的清洁VAE潜质中缺失可信度的主要证据. 一个固定的、无培训的非线性,即局部帧到帧变化的大小,使它从同样的潜想中可以读取:线性读取在IntPhys上达到78%的对等精度,80%与网格特征一起(第4.6节)。 真正失败的是什么? blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: HumanML3D ( Guo et al., 2022 ) established the standard benchmark and a redundant pose representation with root velocities, joint positions, velocities and rotations, and binary foot-contact labels. MotionDiffuse ( Zhang et al., 2022 ) was among the first diffusion models for text-to-motion generation, predicting the noise at every step, and MDM ( Tevet et al., 2023 ) applies a transformer diffusion model directly to this representation and predicts the clean motion. Tokenized approaches quantize motion and model the token sequence, autoregressively ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) or with masked modeling over residual codebooks ( Guo et al., 2024 ) , and MLD ( Chen et al., 2023a ) runs diffusion in the latent space of a motion autoencoder. Kimodo ( Rempe et al., 2026 ) is a recent large kinematic motion diffusion model trained on studio motion capture and designed to reduce floating and foot skating. We study MDM and MotionDiffuse because both work directly in pose space, so their clean-motion estimate at every step can be scored with the same physics as the final output.
blocks.zh: HumanML3D (Guo等, 2022年)建立了标准基准,并设置了冗余的姿势代表,并有根速度,联合位置,速度和旋转,并有二元脚相接的标签. Motion Diffuse(张等,2022年-)是最早的文本到运动生成的传播模型之一,每一步都预测出噪音,而MDM(特韦特等,2023年-)直接针对这种表示应用了变压器扩散模型并预测了清洁运动. Tokenized方法将运动量化并建模符号序列,自动递归(Zhang等,2023年),或用蒙面模型取而代之于剩余编码本(Guo等,2024年),而MLD(Chen等,2023年a)在运动自编码器的潜在空间进行扩散. 木户 (Rempe等,2026年)是一款近期接受工作室运动捕捉训练并被设计为能减少浮出水面和花脚花样滑冰的大型动能运动扩散模型. 我们研究MDM和MotionDiffuse,因为两者都直接在外形空间中工作,所以它们在每个步骤上的清洁运动估计可以和最终输出相同的物理分数.

blocks.en: The models above are kinematic: they generate poses directly, and floating, foot sliding and ground penetration are widely reported for them. Character animation has long repaired the most common of these artifacts after generation, from predicted foot contacts: PFNN edits each generated pose with a simple two-joint inverse kinematics along the contact labels to remove foot sliding ( Holden et al., 2017 ) , earlier work constrains heel and toe velocity to zero during contact by optimizing in an autoencoder’s hidden space ( Holden et al., 2016 ) , and the Neural State Machine predicts contact labels for feet, hands and hips for use in inverse-kinematics post-processing ( Starke et al., 2019 ) . Such fixes keep planted feet in place, but they cannot make an airborne body fall at the right rate or tell a floating body from a jump. Physics-based controllers instead generate motion inside a simulator, where gravity and contact hold by construction, at the cost of learning a control policy ( Peng et al., 2018 ; Tessler et al., 2024 ) . Hybrids keep a kinematic generator and make its output physical with a simulator: PhysDiff ( Yuan et al., 2023 ) projects intermediate samples through a simulated motion-imitation policy during diffusion, and CLoSD ( Tevet et al., 2024 ) pairs a kinematic diffusion planner with a simulated tracking controller; related systems drive humanoid robots ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Other methods make a kinematic model’s output more physical without simulating it. SimDiff ( Watanabe et al., 2025 ) conditions a frozen MDM on environment parameters learned from simulator-augmented data. PhysibleMDM ( Stölzle et al., 2026 ) optimizes the diffusion noise of a frozen model at inference time against kinematic and inverse-dynamics feasibility measures, and InterPhys ( Xing et al., 2026 ) models human-object, human-scene and internal body forces with soft force- and torque-balance constraints. Guidance steers the sampling of motion diffusion models toward spatial constraints ( Karunratanakul et al., 2023 ; Xie et al., 2024 ) , and noise optimization adjusts the diffusion noise of a frozen model against any loss defined on the generated motion ( Karunratanakul et al., 2024 ) . All of these act on a model’s inputs, outputs, sampling or environment. We ask what a kinematic generator represents internally about the physics it does not enforce, a question that does not arise for physics-based generators, where our labels hold by construction; our early-warning experiment measures how much an internal or decoded signal can save.
blocks.zh: 上面的模型是动能的:它们直接产生外观,浮出水面,脚滑入和地面穿透被广泛报道. 角色动画长期修复这些文物中最常见的出世后, PFNN编辑每个生成的姿势时,在接触标签上使用简单的双联反向动因子来去除脚步滑动(Holden等,2017年),更早的工作通过优化自动编码器的隐藏空间(Holden等,2016年)在接触时将脚跟和脚趾速度限制为0,神经态机器预测脚,手和臀部的接触标签用于逆相后处理(Starke等,2019年). 这样的修补能使被植入的脚保持原地,但是它们不能使空中的身体以正确的速度倒下,也不能告诉浮出水来的身体从跳出. 以物理为基础的控制器反而在模拟器内产生运动,而重力和接触通过构造控制,代价是学习控制政策(Peng等,2018;Tessler等,2024.). Hybrids保留了动能生成器,并用模拟器使其输出物理化: PhysDiff(袁克等,2023年)在扩散过程中通过模拟运动仿真政策预测中间样品,CLOSD(特维特等,2024年)用模拟跟踪控制器将动能扩散计划器配对;相关系统驱动人造机器人(王克等,2026年). 其他方法使得动能模型的输出在物理上更不模拟. SimDiff(Watanabe等,2025年)对从模拟-增强数据中汲取的环境参数规定了冻结的MDM的条件. 物理MDM 软件 (Stölzle等,2026年)优化了在推论时间对动能和反能动能的可行措施进行冷冻模型的传播噪声,而InterPhys(Xing等,2026年)则以软力和扭力平衡约束来模拟人-物体,人-苯和内体力. 指导将运动扩散模型的取样引向空间限制(Karunratanakul等,2023;Xie等,2024),噪声优化使被冻结模型的传播噪声适应所产生运动上确定的任何损失(Karunratanakul等,2024)。 所有这些行动都以模型的投入、产出、取样或环境为基础。 我们问一个动能生成器在内部对于它不执行的物理代表什么,这个问题对于基于物理的生成器来说并不产生,我们的标签是用构造来标注的;我们的预警实验衡量一个内部信号或解码信号能节省多少.

blocks.en: Linear probes reveal scene geometry such as depth in latent image diffusion models ( Chen et al., 2023b ) . In video encoders, speed and acceleration become linearly accessible at intermediate depth, with control tasks and attentive probes as comparisons ( Joseph et al., 2026 ) . Layerwise probing has since been compared across video foundation models with different pretraining ( Punzo et al., 2026 ) and extended to camera motion, intuitive physics and anomalies ( Musa et al., 2026 ) , and the probe direction at such layers has been used to steer an encoder’s physical expectations ( Alam, 2026 ) . For video diffusion transformers, Kneifl et al. (2026) fit ridge probes to activations of forward-noised simulated videos and report that speed, momentum and gravity are decodable well beyond what ridge probes recover from the noisy input latent; for gravity the margin persists as the input becomes clean, while for rolling speed the clean latent eventually carries the information. Esmati et al. (2026) invert real videos through the model and find plausibility linearly decodable from mean-pooled transformer states, while a linear probe on the clean VAE latent is at chance. Tang et al. (2026) use probes on denoising features to prune implausible video candidates early, comparing against random selection, best-of- N N selection, preference tuning and a likelihood-based scorer. In image diffusion, CNN probes on early denoising signals predict the quality of the final image ( Cui et al., 2026 ) . Similar probes outperform an off-the-shelf evaluator applied to the decoded clean estimate ( Guo et al., 2026 ) , and in diffusion driving planners, first-step state probes select better trajectories than a privileged score of the clean preview’s true quality in three of four settings ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Without probes, video models that predict masked content in a learned representation space show violation-of-expectation effects on intuitive-physics benchmarks including IntPhys, while pixel-space video prediction stays closer to chance ( Garrido et al., 2025 ) . Guo et al. (2026) and Zhang et al. (2026) do compare probes with the clean estimate, but they read it with an off-the-shelf evaluator or score it by its true quality. None compares the internal probe with an equally flexible, equally tuned readout of the model’s own clean-sample estimate, measures what the layer adds to that estimate, or reports how that comparison depends on training-set size. These are the comparisons we add, together with within-prompt scoring for generated samples; Esmati et al. (2026) do score pairs within a scene, which we adopt for our video test. Unlike Kneifl et al. (2026) and Esmati et al. (2026) , we also record along the model’s own sampling trajectory rather than from noised simulated videos or inverted real ones.
blocks.zh: 线性探测器揭示出场景几何,如潜在图像扩散模型中的深度(Chen等,2023b.). 在视频编码器中,速度和加速度在中间深度成为可线性可取性,以控制任务和细心探针作为比较(Joseph等,2026). 从那时起,对不同预应性(Punzo等,2026年)的视频基础模型进行层层探测比较,并扩大到相机运动、直觉物理和异常(Musa等,2026年),这些地层的探测方向被用来引导编码器的物理预期(Alam,2026年)。 对于视频扩散变压器,Kneifl等人(2026年)安装了山脊探测器,以激活前向噪声模拟录像,并报告说,速度、动力和重力的可解密程度远远超出山脊探测器从噪音输入潜入中恢复的速度;对于地心引力,随着输入变得干净,山脊探测器一直存在;对于滚动速度,清洁潜入物最终携带信息。 Esmati等人(2026年)通过模型反转了真实的视频,并且从平均集合变压器状态下发现可信线性可解码,而对于干净的VAE潜伏的线性探测器则有可能. Tang等 (2026)早期使用去名特征的探针来prune不可信的视频候选人,与随机选择,最佳N选取,偏好调取和基于概率的分数比较. 在图像传播中,CNN对早期去名信号的探针预测了最终图像的质量(Cui等,2026年). 类似的探测器比现成评价员在解码清洁估计(Guo等,2026年)中的表现要好,在传播驱动规划中,第一步状态探测器在四种环境中的三个环境选择了比清洁预览真实质量的特权分更好的轨迹(Zhang等,2026年). 没有探针,预测所学表现空间中被遮掩的内容的视频模型显示出对直觉物理基准(包括IntPhys)的违反预期效应,而像素-空间视频预测则更接近于机会(Garrido等,2025年). 郭等 (2026年)和张等 (2026年)确实将探测器与清洁估计进行了比较,但他们与现成评价员一起读取,或者按其真实质量来评分. 没有人能将内部探测器比作一个同样灵活、同样调取模型本身的清洁抽样估计、衡量该图层对该估计增加什么,或者报告这种比较如何取决于训练的大小。 这些都是我们添加的比较, 以及生成的样本的瞬间评分; Esmati 等 (2026) 在一个场景中做分数对, 我们采用它进行视频测试。 与Kneifl等人(2026年)和Esmati等人(2026年)不同,我们也记录了模型本身的采样轨迹,而不是来自被点名的模拟录像或倒置的真实录像.

blocks.en: Linear probes ( Alain & Bengio, 2016 ) measure what a fixed readout can decode, not what a model uses or contains ( Belinkov, 2022 ) . Control tasks separate a representation’s content from what a probe can memorize ( Hewitt & Liang, 2019 ) . An information-theoretic view argues that the best-performing probe should be used, shows with the data-processing inequality that a contextual representation carries no more information about a property than the sentence it was computed from, and therefore measures the gain over a control representation, noting that ease of extraction still lacks a formal definition ( Pimentel et al., 2020b ) ; minimum-description-length probing makes the dependence on probe complexity and data size explicit ( Voita & Titov, 2020 ) , and Pareto probing reports accuracy against probe complexity rather than at one capacity ( Pimentel et al., 2020a ) . Usable ( 𝒱 \mathcal{V} -) information ( Xu et al., 2020 ) resolves the tension between these views: Shannon information cannot grow under processing, but the information a given family of readouts can extract can. Conditional probing ( Hewitt et al., 2021 ) applies this to ask what a representation adds beyond a baseline representation, by comparing a readout of the baseline with a readout of both. Amnesic probing asks a different question, whether a model uses a property, by removing it and measuring the change in behavior ( Elazar et al., 2021 ) ; we do not test use. Our comparison is a conditional probe whose baseline is the model’s own clean-sample estimate, which is a known deterministic function of the probed activations and the noisy input (and, in MotionDiffuse, the text). That fixes the direction of the Shannon comparison and leaves usable information under a stated readout family as the quantity to measure (Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: 线性探测器(Alain & Bengio, 2016) 测量一个固定的读出可以解码,而不是模型使用或包含什么(Belinkov, 2022). 控制任务将一个代理的内容与探测器能够记住的内容相分离(Hewitt & Liang, 2019). 一种信息理论观点认为,应使用最出色的探测器,从数据处理的不平等性中显示,背景表示没有比它从中计算出的句子更多的财产信息,因此衡量控制表示的增益,同时指出,提取的便捷性仍缺乏正式定义(Pimentel等人,2020年b);最小描述长度的探测使得对探测器复杂性和数据大小的依赖性变得明确(Voita & Titov,2020年),Pareto检验报告准确性以探测器复杂性而不是一种能力(Pimentel等人,2020年a)。 可使用(V\mathcal{V}-)信息(徐等,2020年)解决了这些观点之间的矛盾: 香农信息不能在处理中增长,但特定读取家族的信息可以提取出. 有条件的检验(Hewitt等人,2021年)采用这一方法,通过将基准的读出与两者的读出进行比较,询问一种表示值在基准表示值之外增加了什么. 失忆症探析提出了另一个问题,一个模型是否使用一个属性,方法是去除它并测量行为的变化(Elazar等,2021);我们不测试使用. 我们的比较是一个有条件的探测器,其基线是模型本身的清洁样本估计,这是探测活化和噪音输入(在MotionDiffuse中是文本)的已知决定性功能。 这决定了香农比较的方向,将可用信息留给一个申报的读出家庭作为衡量数量(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: We study MDM ( Tevet et al., 2023 ) , a kinematic diffusion model: a transformer encoder (8 layers, width 512) with a CLIP text encoder, using two official HumanML3D checkpoints: the 50-step model and the original 1000-step model. Both generate 120 frames (6 s at 20 fps) in the HumanML3D representation ( Guo et al., 2022 ) , with classifier-free guidance at scale 2.5. At six denoising steps, evenly spaced from the first to the last, we record the output of every transformer layer at every fourth frame (dropping the condition token), the noisy input 𝒙 t {\bm{x}}_{t} , and the model’s clean-motion estimate 𝒙 ^ 0 \hat{\bm{x}}_{0} with its decoded joints. Guidance runs a conditional and an unconditional pass; we record the activations of the conditional pass and the guided estimate that the sampler uses. “20% of denoising” denotes the second recorded step (step 10 of 50, or 200 of 1000). Figure 2 summarizes what we record and compare.

blocks.en: To test whether the results depend on MDM’s design, we repeat the main analyses on MotionDiffuse ( Zhang et al., 2022 ) , also kinematic but different where it matters. It predicts the noise rather than the clean motion, so its estimate 𝒙 ^ 0 = ( 𝒙 t − 1 − α ¯ t ​ ϵ ^ ) / α ¯ t \hat{\bm{x}}_{0}=({\bm{x}}_{t}-\sqrt{1-\bar{\alpha}_{t}}\,\hat{\bm{\epsilon}})/\sqrt{\bar{\alpha}_{t}} is computed from its prediction and the noisy input; it uses no guidance; and its 8 transformer layers (width 512, linear attention, one token per frame) receive the text in every layer, through cross-attention and stylization blocks, rather than as a token. We use its official HumanML3D checkpoint and sampler (1000 DDPM steps), the same prompts, seeds, frames and recorded steps as for MDM (20% of denoising is step 200), and choose its layers by the same rule as MDM’s (Section 3.3 ; layer 3 for balance, layer 6 for flight and gravity). Its noise schedule is linear where MDM’s is cosine, so a given fraction of denoising is noisier for MotionDiffuse (Table 9 ). Since the text reaches every layer, its estimate is a function of its activations, the noisy input and the text, ( 𝒂 ℓ , 𝒙 t , u ) ({\bm{a}}_{\ell},{\bm{x}}_{t},u) in the notation of Section 3.3 , so for this model the bound of Section 3.3 includes the text, which is one reason we also test the text directly.
blocks.zh: 为了检验结果是否取决于MDM的设计,我们重复了对MotionDiffuse(张等,2022年)的主要分析,这些分析也是动态的,但在不同的地方不同。 它预测的是噪音而不是干净的运动,因此其估计值x ^ 0 = (x t – 1 – α → ^ ^ ) ; 其8个变压器层(width 512,线性注意,每帧一个符号)通过相向和分解块在每一层接收文本,而不是作为符号. 我们使用其官方的HumanML3D检查点和采样器(1 000 DDPM步骤)、与MDM相同的提示、种子、帧和记录步骤(20%的去诺是200步骤),并以与MDM相同的规则选择其层(第3.3节;第3层为平衡;第6层为飞行和重力)。 它的噪声表是线性的, MDM 的同心圆, 所以给定的去诺是MotionDiffuse的噪声(表9). 由于文本到达了每一层,所以其估计是其活化,高吵的输入和文本的函数,(一个l, x t, u) (\bm{a}}_{\ell},\bm{x}}_{t}, u)在3.3节的注解中,所以对于这个模型,3.3节的束缚包含了文本,这也是我们直接测试文本的一个原因.

blocks.en: The prompt set combines 64 curated prompts (everyday locomotion, jumps and hops, balance-challenging actions, upper-body actions) with 186 captions sampled from the HumanML3D test split, 250 in total, and each prompt is sampled 4 times: 1,000 motions per run. We run each model with three seeds: 6,000 motions from the two MDM checkpoints and 3,000 from MotionDiffuse. Because few of these motions contain flight, we also run every model on a jump-heavy prompt set with three seeds: the 14 curated jump, hop, leap and skip prompts plus one caption from every HumanML3D test motion whose caption names one of these actions, 245 distinct prompts sampled 4 times each (2,940 motions per model). A pilot used only the curated prompts (256 motions), every second frame, and a single held-out set of 12 prompts.
blocks.zh: 该快取集将64个被曲解的快取(每天的运动,跳跃和跳跃,平衡-挑战动作,上体动作)与从HumanML3D测试分拆中抽取的186个字幕,共250个,每个快取集被抽取4次:每跑1000个动作. 我们以三个种子运行每个模型:来自两个MDM检查站的6000个运动和来自Motion Diffuse的3000个运动. 由于这些动作中很少包含飞行,我们还运行了每个模型在一个有三种种子的跳出-重力快取集上:14个被曲解的跳出,跳出,跳出和跳出快取的快取,加上每个HumanML3D测试动作的一个标题,其标题名称之一是其中一项动作,245个显著的快取,每个快取4次(每个快取2,940个动作). 一名飞行员只使用了被整理的提示(256个动议),每秒一个框架,以及一套12个提示。

blocks.en: In our data, a linear probe on MDM’s last layer predicts the final motion’s dynamic balance better than the balance computed from the model’s own estimate at the same step (Table 2 ). It is tempting to conclude that the model knows how balanced the motion will be and fails to show it. But the estimate is computed from that layer, so everything it contains about balance has passed through the layer. The probe’s advantage can mean only that the layer holds the information in a form a linear readout finds easy, while the estimate holds it in a form that needs a nonlinear readout or a computed quantity. To call the knowledge hidden, a readout of the layer has to beat an equally flexible readout of the estimate, or add to it. The rest of this section makes the argument precise.
blocks.zh: 在我们的数据中,一个MDM上一层的线性探测器预测出最终运动的动态平衡比从模型自己在同一步骤上估计的平衡要好(表2)。 令人诱惑的结论是,模型知道运动将如何平衡,未能显示。 但估计是从这个层次计算的, 所以它包含的关于平衡的一切 都经过了这个层次。 探测器的优点只能是,层层以线性读取的形式保存信息,而估计值以需要非线性读取或计算数量的形式保存。 要调用隐藏的知识,层的读取必须比起同样灵活的读取估计值,或者加入到其中去. 本节其余部分使论据准确.

blocks.en: For each label and recorded step we compare six readouts, each predicting the final motion’s per-frame label: • Explicit : the same label computed from the estimate’s joints, with a linear calibration fit on the training folds (for the flight AUC, the raw value); • Estimate, linear : a ridge probe on the estimate’s 263 features, the usual baseline in probing studies; • Estimate, MLP : a small MLP on everything the estimate shows, that is its 263 features plus the labels computed from it (Section 3.2 , with foot contacts and foot sliding speed) and indicators for undefined values; • Layer, linear and Layer, MLP : ridge and the same MLP on one layer’s 512 activations at the frame (its slice of 𝒂 ℓ {\bm{a}}_{\ell} ); • Estimate + layer, MLP : the same MLP on both, which asks whether the layer adds anything to what the estimate shows. We also report a ridge probe on the noisy input 𝒙 t {\bm{x}}_{t} . Ridge probes standardize their inputs and choose the penalty from { 1 , 10 , … , 10 4 } \{1,10,\dots,10^{4}\} by efficient leave-one-out cross-validation on the training frames. The MLP has two hidden layers of 256 units with ReLU and dropout 0.1, and is trained with AdamW (learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} , weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} ) with early stopping on 15% of the training prompts. The layer is fixed per label as the one with the best mean linear score at 20% of denoising: layer 7 for both balance measures, 6 for flight, and 5 for gravity and its two parts, on both MDM checkpoints. This choice favors the layer in a standalone comparison; for what the layer adds to the estimate, we also test every layer and all layers together (Section 4.3 ).

blocks.en: The fixed MLP and the leave-one-out penalty (which validates on frames of motions seen in training) could each favor one side. We therefore repeat the comparison with every run of a checkpoint pooled, three seeds and 3,000 motions, under five folds grouped by prompt across seeds, and with every readout tuned on a validation split of 15% of the training prompts. The families are ridge, with the penalty chosen from 10 − 1 10^{-1} to 10 6 10^{6} ; an MLP family that adds a linear map to an MLP, so that it contains the linear readout, with five configurations (64 to 1024 hidden units, one or two hidden layers, dropout 0.1 or 0.3, weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} to 10 − 2 10^{-2} ); and, as the tuned readout, whichever of the two has the lower validation error. The same procedure reads the estimate’s 263 raw features alone, everything the estimate shows, the layer, and estimate and layer together. The conditional gain uses a readout of estimate and layer that may fall back to the estimate alone: among the candidates for both inputs and for the estimate alone, it keeps the one with the lowest validation error, so that the larger input cannot lower the score merely by being harder to fit. Confidence intervals resample prompts with replacement (1,000 replicates, the same draw for every readout). They do not include training variance, which we measure by refitting with two further validation splits and initializations. We report many intervals (targets, models, layers and steps) without correcting for multiplicity, read them as descriptive, and draw conclusions only from patterns that hold across models, layers and scores. The analysis was not preregistered: the tuned readouts, the jump-heavy runs, the split of flight gravity and the second model were added after the first results (Appendix B ).

blocks.en: All readouts share five folds grouped by prompt, so no test prompt is seen in training. We report R 2 R^{2} for continuous labels and ROC-AUC for flight and for floats or falls, pooled over all test frames. Since physics differs greatly between prompts, a readout could score well by recognizing the prompt alone. The within-prompt score removes that possibility: we subtract each prompt’s mean from both target and prediction and report the Pearson correlation of the residuals, which only sample-specific information can raise. A prompt also says when things tend to happen (a jump in the middle of the clip, say), which a per-frame readout could exploit within a prompt. With seeds pooled, the within-prompt-and-frame score removes this as well, by subtracting the mean over the 12 samples of the same prompt at the same frame. blocks.en: Can a sample that will float be caught partway through sampling and replaced? A sample fails if its final motion has any floating. We compare four strategies and count cost in denoising steps per delivered motion (1 = one full sample): generating once; finish, then filter , which checks the final motion and regenerates if it floats; early abort , which scores the sample at 20% or 40% of denoising and restarts it if the score is high; and early abort followed by the final check. Retries stop after a budget of attempts, and the last attempt is always delivered. The early score is (i) a training-free rule, abort if the decoded estimate already shows floating; (ii) a ridge readout, trained out of fold and set to abort the same share of samples, of everything the estimate shows (its features averaged over frames and its per-sample failure rates), of the frame-averaged activations of one layer (layer 3 of the 50-step model and layer 6 of the 1000-step model, each chosen on the first seed), or of both; (iii) random aborts at the same rate; or (iv) a perfect detector, as a ceiling. All strategies are simulated with the same random draws, on the 6,000 recorded MDM samples. Each already contains its estimate at every recorded step and its final motion, so every decision uses what an online run would see; a retry draws another recorded sample of the same prompt (200 simulated requests per prompt). Strategies that end with the final check are compared at equal delivered failure by varying the budget from 1 to 20 attempts.

blocks.en: When MDM’s bodies leave the ground and fall, they fall at close to the right rate (Table 1 ): the median fitted gravity on the curated jump prompts is 9.54 to 9.75 m/s 2 for the 50-step model and 9.13 to 9.22 m/s 2 for the 1000-step model, somewhat slower than real jumps in the processed form of its training data (median 10.33 m/s 2 , Appendix E ). Individual stretches spread widely around these medians (standard deviation 2.24 m/s 2 on the jump-heavy runs, against 0.7 to 1.0 m/s 2 for real jumps). The common failure is floating. On HumanML3D test captions, 3.8 to 4.7% of the 50-step model’s frames lie in floating stretches, against 8.6 to 9.7% for the 1000-step model. On the curated jump prompts the figures are 0.6 to 0.8% and 4.8 to 9.3%. The raised-contact rate, a foot in contact but more than 5 cm up, follows the same pattern. Part of the floating is implied by the prompt: a person “walking on a balance beam” is generated without a beam and floats in nearly every sample. On test captions the original 1000-step checkpoint floats about twice as often as the 50-step one, in all three seeds and under every threshold setting we tried (Appendix D ). On real motion capture the same labels flag floating in 0.09% of frames (Appendix E ).

blocks.en: Table 3 and Figure 5 compare the readouts with the three seeds of each model pooled and every readout tuned on held-out prompts (Section 3.3 ). A first version with one fixed MLP per seed gives the same ordering (Appendix B ). For balance and flight the estimate is read as well as the layer: for both balance measures its tuned readout beats the tuned layer, by 0.015 to 0.029 in R 2 R^{2} on both MDM checkpoints and by 0.12 and 0.18 on MotionDiffuse, and for flight the estimate ties or leads. Adding the layer to the estimate gains nothing. With the readout that may fall back to the estimate, every interval covers zero or lies below it, across prompts and within prompt and frame, and so does every interval in two refits with other validation splits and initializations, run for dynamic balance on the 50-step model. The layer sweep shows the same for every layer: none adds more than 0.007, and only one interval, for flight at layer 7 of the 1000-step model, barely excludes zero (Figure 6 ). On MDM, whose conditional estimate is a fixed linear map of layer 7, a gain from that layer could come only from directions the output head discards.
blocks.zh: 表3和图5比较了每个模式组合的三种种子的读取和每个被搁置的提示的读取(第3.3节)。 每个种子有一个固定的MLP的第一个版本给出同样的订单(附录B. 关于平衡和飞行,估计数和图层均改为:对于平衡计量,其调制读取比调制取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取 将图层添加到估计值中不会有什么收益. 随着读出可能回落到估计值,每个间隔覆盖了0或位于它下方,跨出提示并处于即时和帧内,并且每个间隔在两个重合中与其他验证分出并初始化,运行在50步模型上的动态平衡. 层层扫地显示每层都相同:每层没有增加超过0.07分,只有1个间隔,用于1000步模型第7层的飞行,几乎排除了0分(图6. 在MDM上,它的有条件估计是第7层的固定线性映射,从该层得到的收益只能取自输出头丢弃的方向.

blocks.en: This null result is not produced by the estimator. Without the fallback, the larger readout scores within 0.003 of the estimate or below it for balance and flight, so the fallback hides no gain there. It keeps the estimate alone in one to five of the five folds (Table 8 ). On the scale of Proposition 1 , the largest balance gain is 0.001 nats, against 0.063 for the fall rate below.
blocks.zh: 这种无效结果不是由估计者产生的. 没有倒数,较大的读出分数在估计值的0.003分以内或低于它进行平衡和飞行,所以倒数隐藏在那里没有收益. 它将估计数单独保留在五折中的一至五折中(表8)。 在提案1的规模上,最大余额收益为0.001纳特,低于0.063。

blocks.en: A positive control shows what the protocol can detect (Table 10 ). We take the estimate readout’s out-of-fold residual, add noise so that its best linear use would raise R 2 R^{2} by 0.005, 0.01 or 0.02 on the squared-error scale, add it to the layer’s activations along a random direction, and rerun the protocol unchanged on the 50-step model. For dynamic balance even the smallest signal is found: the gain is + 0.013 +0.013 [ 0.009 0.009 , 0.017 0.017 ], more than the linear amount because the tuned readouts extract more, against + 0.000 +0.000 [ − 0.001 -0.001 , 0.001 0.001 ] for the real layer. For flight and floating the pooled AUC, near 0.97, barely moves even at 0.02, partly because the readouts are selected by squared error. The within-prompt-and-frame score does find the signal, from 0.005 for flight and from 0.01 for floating on the jump prompts, and on that score the real layer adds nothing ( − 0.008 -0.008 and 0.000 0.000 ). For these two targets the evidence for no gain is therefore that score, and a gain below 0.01 for floating could go undetected.
blocks.zh: 一个正控显示协议可以检测到什么(表10.). 我们把估计读出值的出值残值,加上噪音,使其最佳的线性使用在平方-误差尺度上将R 2 R^{2}提高0.005,0.01或0.02, 沿着随机方向加入地层活化,并在50步模型上重新运行协议不变. 对于动态平衡,甚至发现最小的信号:增益为+0.013 + 0.013 [0.009 0.009,0.017 0.017],比起线性量,因为调取的读取取取出量多,而实际地层取取出+ 0.000 + 0.000 [− 0.001-0.001,0.0001]. 对于飞行和漂浮集合的AUC,接近0.97,甚至在0.02时几乎不动,部分原因是读出是用平方错误选择的. 瞬间和瞬间得分确实找到信号,从0.005起为飞行,从0.01起为跳跃提示所浮出水面,再到这个得分,真正的分层没有增加任何(-0.008-0.08和0.000.000.). 因此,对于这两个目标来说,无益的证据是得分,而浮动所得低于0.01的得分可能得不到发现。

blocks.en: Two details show where the estimate’s advantage comes from. First, the readout family matters: restricted to linear readouts, the layer does add a little (up to 0.02 on MDM, 0.05 to 0.07 on MotionDiffuse), so part of what the estimate shows needs a nonlinear readout. Second, on MDM the input matters more than the family: from its 263 raw features alone the tuned estimate only ties the tuned layer, and the physics labels computed from it add about 0.02 for dynamic balance (Table 7 ). On MotionDiffuse the raw features alone already beat the tuned layer, by 0.12 and 0.18 (Table 3 ), and the labels add nothing. A temporal readout that sees all 30 recorded frames gives the same ordering in all six runs (Appendix A ). In the terms of Section 3.3 , the usable information the layer adds about balance and flight depends on the readout family, and for the most flexible readouts we tried it is indistinguishable from zero.
blocks.zh: 有两个细节说明估计数的优势来自何处。 首先,读出家事:限于线性读出,层会增加一点(在MDM上最多为0.02个,在MotionDiffuse上为0.05到0.07个),因此部分估计显示需要非线性读出. 第二,在MDM上,输入比家庭更重要:单从其263个原始特征来看,被调取的估计数只将调取的地层联系起来,从中计算出来的物理标签为动态平衡增加了大约0.02(表7)。 在 MotionDiffuse 上,仅原始特性就已经比起调制层,以0.12和0.18(表3),而标签没有增加任何内容. 一个看到所有30个被记录帧的时间读出在所有6个运行中给出相同的顺序(Appendix A.). 在3.3节中,该层增加的关于平衡和飞行的可用信息取决于读取家族,对于我们尝试的最灵活的读取,它与零是无法区分的.

blocks.en: Figure 6: The gain from adding one layer, or all eight, to the tuned readout of the estimate (with fallback, 20% of denoising, 95% intervals; colors as in Figure 5 ). Circles: main data; diamonds: jump prompts; open markers and dashed lines: the 1000-step model. Top row, MDM: only the fall rate rises well above zero, from layer 3 on (layer 2 on the 1000-step model); the floating gains stay at about 0.01 or less. Bottom row, MotionDiffuse: the same pattern with a smaller fall-rate gain, from layers 5 to 7, and a floating gain only on the main data’s 50 prompts. The main data’s fall rate is not shown (too few falling frames).
blocks.zh: 图6:将一层或全部八层添加到对估计数的调取读取(含倒数20%的去诺,间隔为95%;颜色如图5所显示)的收益。 圆:主数据; 方块:跳出提示; 开出标记和虚线:1000步模型. 上行,MDM:从第3层起,只有下行率远高于0;从第3层起(第2层为1000步模型上);浮动收益保持在0.01左右. 下行,MotionDiffuse:相同的图案,从第5层到第7层,降速率增益较小,只有主数据50个速率的浮动增益. 主要数据的下降率没有显示(下降帧太少).

blocks.en: The fitted flight gravity mixes two questions. In the main data most of its labelled frames (76% and 83%) lie in floating stretches, so its score mostly measures whether an airborne body floats or falls, and only 57 and 78 prompts contain falling frames, too few for reliable tuned readouts. We therefore split the target (Section 3.2 ) and use the jump-heavy runs, in which most labelled frames fall (11,640 and 13,444 frames from 233 and 240 prompts).
blocks.zh: 装配的飞行重力混合了两个问题. 在主要数据中,它的标注框(76%和83%)大多位于浮动拉伸上,因此它的分数大多是衡量空中机体是浮起还是倒起,只有57和78个提示包含倒下框,对于可靠的调值读取来说太少了. 因此,我们拆分目标(第3.2节),使用跳跃式重力跑道,其中大多数标有标签的相框倒下(从233和240个相框跌出11 640个相框和13 444个相框)。

blocks.en: Whether an airborne body floats or falls is visible in the estimate on the jump prompts, where 236 prompts have airborne stretches on the 50-step model. Its tuned readout reaches an AUC of 0.97 on both MDM checkpoints, and no single layer, nor all eight together, adds more than 0.007 in pooled AUC (Figure 6 ). Across the three fits the layer adds at most 0.004 0.004 in pooled AUC, and 0.019 0.019 [ 0.008 0.008 , 0.030 0.030 ] within prompt in one of them. The layer adds more only in the smaller main data, where just 106 prompts have airborne stretches. There, on the 50-step model, it adds + 0.008 +0.008 [ 0.001 0.001 , 0.015 0.015 ] in pooled AUC and + 0.054 +0.054 [ 0.013 0.013 , 0.089 0.089 ] in the within-prompt correlation, and in two refits up to 0.014 0.014 pooled and 0.08 0.08 to 0.11 0.11 within prompt and frame.
blocks.zh: 在跳跃提示上的估计中可以看到一具空心机体浮出水面或坠入水面,其中236个空心机在50步模型上有空心拉伸. 它的调制读取在两个MDM检查站都达到0.97的AUC,没有一层,也没有八个加起来,在集合的AUC中增加了超过0.007(图6)。 整个三层加在一起的AUC最多为0.0040.004分,其中一层在即时增加0.019分[0.008.0.008分,0.030.0.030分]。 该地层只增加了较小的主数据,其中只有106个导管有空中拉伸. 在50步模型上,它增加了+0.008+0.008 [0.001 0.001,0.015 0.015]的集合AUC和+0.054 + 0.054 [0.013 0.013,0.089 0.089] 的瞬间关联,并两次在0.014 0.014 的集合和0.08到0.11 0.11的瞬间和框架内进行回配.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Held-out predictions of the final fall rate on the jump prompts (50-step model, 20% of denoising, tuned readouts; density of falling stretches in cells of 0.25 m/s 2 , darker for more). (a) From the estimate alone and (b) with layer 5 added (with fallback); dashed: perfect prediction; R 2 R^{2} per frame, as in Table 3 . (c) Among jumps that travel at least 0.4 m, the three where adding the layer reduces the error most, selected for that reason: the final motion at take-off, apex and landing, its center-of-mass path (red while airborne), and the estimate’s path at 20% (dashed).
blocks.zh: 图7:跳跃提示上最后跌倒率的挂起预测(50步模型,去诺能的20%,调取读取;在0.25 m/s 2 的细胞中倒倒倒拉长的密度更深). (a) 仅从估计值中取出,(b) 加上第5层(有倒数);破损:完美预测;R 2 R^{2}每帧,见表3。 (c) 在至少行走0.4米的跳跃中,增加地层的三个跳跃会减少最多的误差,为此原因选定:起飞、顶点和起落时的最后运动、其质量中心路径(在空中时为红色)和估计的路径为20%。

blocks.en: Figure 8: The fall rate of jumps across denoising (jump prompts, layer 5, tuned readouts, seeds pooled). (a) A typical jump, drawn from the estimate at 0% and 20% of denoising and from the final motion (center of mass red while airborne), and its center-of-mass height at every recorded step with that step’s fitted fall rate. At 0% the estimate is a crouched average pose; from 20% the jump is in place, and its height and fall rate change by only a few centimeters and about 1 m/s 2 afterwards. The jump is chosen by a fixed rule: among falling stretches of the 50-step runs that travel at least 0.4 m, the one whose 20% fall-rate error is the median (1.0 m/s 2 ). (b, c) R 2 R^{2} for the final fall rate from the estimate and from estimate and layer together; the shaded gap is the gain. Gray: the estimate’s own fitted fall rate, and the layer alone. (d) The gain, with 95% intervals: largest at 20%, below 0.02 by 60%.
blocks.zh: 图 8:跳过自点心的跳出率(跳出提示,第5层,调取读取,种子集合). (a) 典型的跳跃,取自0和20%的去诺,取自最后运动(空气中为质量红色的中心),其质量中心高度在每一有记录的阶段都与该步骤的下降率相匹配。 估计值为0%,是一个蹲下的平均姿势;从20%起,跳跃到位,其高度和下降率仅变化了几厘米,之后大约1米/秒2。 跳跃是按固定规则选择的:在至少行走0.4米的50步跑的下行拉长中,20%的下行误差为中值(1.0 m/s 2 .). (b,c)R 2 R^{2}从估计和从估计和分层加在一起的下行减速率;阴差为增益. Gray: 估计本身的下降率, (d) 收益,间隔为95%:最大,为20%,低于0.02,增加60%。

blocks.en: The fall rate of the stretches that do fall is the one case in which the layers know more. On the jump prompts of the 50-step model, adding the layer raises R 2 R^{2} from 0.35 to 0.43, a gain of + 0.077 +0.077 [ 0.051 0.051 , 0.107 0.107 ], or 0.063 nats (Tables 3 and 8 , Figure 7 ), with similar gains within prompt and frame and in two refits. With more training prompts the gain first shrinks and then levels off from 100 prompts on (0.085, then 0.077; Figure 9 b). It replicates on the 1000-step model ( + 0.076 +0.076 [ 0.053 0.053 , 0.096 0.096 ]), though there it is smaller within prompt and frame ( + 0.021 +0.021 ) and with fewer training prompts (Figure 9 c), and the layer alone is no longer clearly ahead of the estimate (0.309 against 0.287, an interval that covers zero), so the two carry partly different information. On both MDM checkpoints every layer from 3 to 7 adds 0.06 to 0.08 (Figure 6 ). The standard comparison overstates even this genuine case: the layer’s ridge probe beats the explicit label by three times the conditional gain on the 50-step model and 1.5 times on the 1000-step model, because the fall rate fitted to a 20% estimate predicts the final one poorly.
blocks.zh: 伸展的倒下率确实会下降,是层层知道更多情况的一个案例. 在50步模型的跳动提示上,加入地层将R 2 R^{2}从0.35升至0.43,增收+0.077+0.077 [0.051 0.051,0.107 0.107],即0.063纳特(表3和8,图7 ),在即时和帧内,并分出两回取相类似的增收. 随着更多的培训,收益首先会减少,然后从100个升起(0.085起,再从0.077起;图9b起)。 它在1000步模型上复制(+0.076+0.076 [0.053 0.053,0.096 0.096]),虽然在快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快 在两个MDM检查站,从3层到7层都增加了0.06至0.08层(图6)。 标准比较甚至夸大了这一真实案例:层脊探测器将50步模型的附带条件收益和1000步模型的1.5倍比明确标记高出三倍,因为20 % 估计值的下降率预示着最后的下降率。

blocks.en: Four checks leave the gain in place. It is not only the layer knowing where a jump is: in 92% of the 11,640 falling frames, from 7,125 falling stretches, the 20% estimate is airborne too, and there the layer still adds + 0.069 +0.069 . It is not a weak readout of the estimate’s timing: the estimate’s readout already includes its own fitted fall rate, and a temporal readout over all 30 recorded frames still leaves the layer ahead in every seed (Appendix A ). It is not the text: giving the readout the prompt’s CLIP embedding, the model’s own text input, does not help on held-out prompts, and the layer’s gain beyond estimate and text is unchanged. And label noise is not the ceiling: on real motion capture the gravity label’s spread would allow an R 2 R^{2} of 0.81 to 0.91 (Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: 四道检查使收益到位. 不仅知道跳跃位置的地层:在11,640个跌倒架中的92%,从7,125个跌倒拉长起,20%的估计也是空降的,在那里,地层仍然增加了+0.069+0.069. 它并不是对估计时间的微弱读出:估计的读出已经包括了它自己安装的倒计时率,而且对所有30个记录框的时间读出仍然使每个种子的地层领先(附录A )。 它不是文本:让读出提示的 CLIP 嵌入,模型本身的文本输入,对被搁置的提示没有帮助,层层的收益超出估计和文本,没有变化. 而标签噪声不是天花板:在真实的运动上捕获重力标签的散射会允许0.81到0.91的R 2 R^{2}(附录E.

blocks.en: The gain is, however, transient (Figure 8 ). At 40% of denoising layer 5 still adds 0.043 on both MDM checkpoints (Figure 8 d). By 60% no layer adds more than 0.02, and at 80% the interval for layer 5 covers zero, because the estimate’s readout improves faster than the layer’s. A separate layer sweep gives up to about 0.06 at 40%, and the same readout differs by up to 0.016 between that sweep and the step run. At a fifth of the denoising steps, then, MDM’s middle and late layers carry information about how fast a jump will fall that its estimate does not yet show in any form we could read: a step-wise case of a model knowing more than it shows, of the kind the video studies report. Such a gain must vanish by the end of sampling, when the final motion is a function of the estimate, so what the measurement adds is its size and duration: about 0.08 in R 2 R^{2} , for about two fifths of the trajectory.
blocks.zh: 然而,收益是短暂的(图8)。 第5层的40%仍然在MDM两个检查站增加0.043(图8d)。 以60 % 的 推算,第5层不会增加超过0.02个,而第5层的间隔为80 % , 因为估计的读取速度比第5层要快。 单层扫描以40%的速度放弃了约0.06,同样的读出值在扫描和分步跑之间则有高达0.016的差异. 然后,MDM的中后层和后层中, 都包含着一个跳跃的速度会下降多少的信息, 估计我们还没有能够读到:一个模型知道比它显示的更多, 这种收益必须在采样结束时消失,当最后运动是估计的一个函数时,那么测量所增加的就是其大小和持续时间:大约为R 2 R^{2},大约为轨道的五分之二.08.

blocks.en: MotionDiffuse (Section 3.1 ) predicts the noise, receives the text in every layer and uses no guidance, and it gives the same picture for balance and flight. On its main data the tuned estimate beats the tuned layer by 0.12 in R 2 R^{2} for dynamic balance and 0.18 for static balance, more than on MDM. Adding any one of its eight layers gains at most 0.001 for dynamic balance, and its chosen layers add nothing for static balance or flight. Floating follows MDM’s pattern: on the main data, where only 50 prompts have airborne stretches, its layers add 0.016 to 0.034 in AUC and the layer alone beats the estimate (0.988 against 0.940), while on its jump prompts (2,940 motions, 235 prompts with such stretches) they add nothing, and the same holds for flight and for the unsplit flight gravity (at most + 0.002 +0.002 ).
blocks.zh: MotionDiffuse(第3.1节)预测出噪音,接收到每层的文字,并且没有使用指向,它为平衡和飞行给出了相同的画面. 在其主要数据上,调制的估计数比MDM上的动态平衡值多出0.12分,而静态平衡值多出0.18分。 加上其八层中的任何一层增益,最多为0.001个来进行动态平衡,而其所选的地层则不会增加静态平衡或飞行. 浮起遵循MDM的模式:在主要数据中,只有50个急流有空中拉伸,其地层在AUC中将0.016加到0.034,单层就比估计值(0.988比0.940)要高,而跳动时的急流(2,940个运动,235个有这种拉伸的急流)则没有增加任何作用,飞行和未散裂飞行重力(最多+0.002+0.002)也一样。

blocks.en: The fall rate again shows a gain, but a smaller and less stable one. At 20% of denoising (step 200 of 1000), adding layer 6 raises R 2 R^{2} from 0.365 to 0.390, + 0.025 +0.025 [ 0.003 0.003 , 0.047 0.047 ] (Table 3 , Figures 5 and 6 ). It holds within prompt ( + 0.022 +0.022 [ 0.007 0.007 , 0.038 0.038 ]), but within prompt and frame its interval covers zero ( + 0.017 +0.017 [ − 0.001 -0.001 , 0.036 0.036 ]), and in two refits with other validation splits and initializations it is + 0.022 +0.022 [ 0.007 0.007 , 0.041 0.041 ] and 0, the fallback keeping the estimate in every fold of the second. It again comes from the later layers (layers 5 to 7 add 0.018 to 0.025 and all eight together 0.047, layers 0 to 3 nothing), the text does not explain it (estimate, text and layer together gain the same + 0.025 +0.025 over the estimate as without the text), and it fades with denoising: + 0.012 +0.012 [ 0.003 0.003 , 0.022 0.022 ] at 40% and + 0.007 +0.007 [ − 0.002 -0.002 , 0.016 0.016 ] at 60%.

At matched noise the gap to MDM is larger still, because the same fraction of denoising is not the same noise level on the two models. At 20% MotionDiffuse’s signal-to-noise ratio is 0.002, against MDM’s 0.10, and it reaches MDM’s range only between 40 and 60% (Table 9 ). At 60%, with a ratio of 0.24, between MDM’s at 20% (0.10) and 40% (0.52), MotionDiffuse’s gain is + 0.007 +0.007 , against MDM’s + 0.077 +0.077 and + 0.043 +0.043 at those steps.

blocks.en: The pilot study pointed the other way: with 64 prompts and one held-out set of 12, the explicit label beat the best layer on dynamic balance (0.832 against 0.814). Training size explains it: the one-feature explicit label barely depends on the number of training prompts, while the 512-feature linear layer probe overtakes it only between 52 and 100 training prompts (Appendix B , Figure 12 ), and the pilot’s 12-prompt test set was also too small to fix the sign. Tuned readouts with pooled seeds show the same dependence (Figure 9 ). For dynamic balance, the one-feature explicit label still beats every trained readout at 25 training prompts on the 50-step model (0.783, against 0.757 for the tuned estimate and 0.617 for the tuned layer), and from 50 prompts on the tuned estimate leads the tuned layer at every size (0.854 against 0.773 at 50, 0.889 against 0.863 at 200). The lead narrows as data grows, from 0.060 at 100 prompts to 0.026 at 200 (0.026 to 0.015 on the 1000-step model), so with much larger training sets the layer’s readout could catch up. The gain from adding the layer, which is what bears on hidden knowledge, stays at zero at every size we measured ( − 0.003 -0.003 to + 0.003 +0.003 with the fallback readout). For the fall rate of jumps on the 50-step model the layer leads at every size, and its lead over the estimate stops shrinking: 0.113 at 50 prompts, 0.076 at 100 and 0.075 at 186. On the 1000-step model the layer alone leads by at most 0.026 from 50 prompts on, and the gain from adding it to the estimate is 0.022 and 0.023 at 50 and 100 prompts and 0.076 at 192. A comparison at one training size can favor either side, and only a lead that persists as data grows is evidence about the model. Video probing benchmarks are of a similar size: the IntPhys development set used in Section 4.6 has 360 videos.

blocks.en: An early signal is useful in practice if it stops samples that will fail. For MDM, the model’s own estimate provides one without any training (Table 5 ). If the estimate shows floating at 20% of denoising, the final motion floats in 80% (50-step) and 82% (1000-step) of cases, and the rule catches 59% and 47% of all floating samples. At 40%, precision rises to 88% and 84%. As a per-sample score, the estimate’s own floating rate also ranks samples within a prompt better than trained readouts. At 20%, its Spearman correlation with the final floating rate after removing prompt means is 0.57 (50-step) and 0.46 (1000-step), against 0.34 and 0.33 for a ridge readout of everything the estimate shows, 0.26 and 0.28 for the same ridge on a layer, and 0.29 and 0.28 for the two together: at the sample level, too, the layer adds nothing to the estimate’s readout, at least for these ridge readouts of frame-averaged inputs. The prompt’s text embedding alone predicts the floating rate only weakly on held-out prompts (Spearman 0.25 and 0.23).
blocks.zh: 早期的信号在实际操作中是有用的,如果它停止了将会失败的样品. 对于MDM来说,模型本身的估计数是未经任何培训的(表5)。 如果估计显示漂浮在去诺的20%,则最终运动会以80%(50步)和82%(1 000步)的病例来漂浮,规则则会捕获所有漂浮样本的59%和47%. 40%,精度上升至88%和84%. 估计的浮动率也比训练有素的阅读率要快。 在20%时,它的斯皮尔曼在移除即时手段后与最终浮动率的关联是:0.57 (50-步)和0.46 (1000-步),而估计值的通脊读取值分别为:0.34和0.33;同层的通脊读取值为0.26和0.28;而两个通脊读取值合计为0.29和0.28:在样本层面,该通脊读取值也没有任何增加,至少这些通框平均输入值的通脊读取值。 提示单嵌入的文本只预测被搁置的提示上浮动率微弱(Spearman 0.25和0.23).

blocks.en: The compute payoff is small (Table 5 , Figure 10 ). Checking the final motion costs almost nothing, so finish-then-filter is the baseline to beat: with two tries it delivers 5.5% floating motions at 1.09 times the compute of a single sample (50-step), and 9.4% at 1.18 (1000-step), against 9.4% and 17.7% when generating once. Early abort without the final check bottoms out at 6.6 to 6.9% and 13.6 to 14.5% floating with the training-free rule, and at 5.5 to 6.3% and 10.3 to 12.0% with the trained readouts. Without the final check, the rule at 20% of denoising delivers within 0.9 percentage points of finish-then-filter at the same compute (mixing budgets of one and two tries), and at 40% it falls behind. With the final check kept, aborting at 20% with the rule saves 3.4 to 6.7% of compute at matched failure for the 50-step model and 4.3 to 9.9% for the 1000-step model, more at stricter targets. The trained readouts, set to abort the same share of samples, save about as much (3.6 to 10.7%) with no consistent order between them: the readout of the estimate, the layer probe, and the two together. At the strictest 50-step target the two that use the layer save less (4.5%, against 6.7 to 6.8%). Random aborts give no gain. Even a perfect detector would save only 6.7 to 14.9% and 11.9 to 22.5%. This ceiling has a closed form.
blocks.zh: 计算付款额很小(表5,图10)。 检查最终运动几乎无所费用,所以完成-当时-过滤器是击败的基准:用两次试射,以1.09倍于单一样本(50步)的计算值,发出5.5%的浮动,以1.18(1 000步)的9.4%,而一次生成时则发出9.4%和17.7%. 未完成最后检查的提前中止,以6.6%至6.9%和13.6%至14.5%的比例随无培训规则漂浮,以5.5%至6.3%和10.3%至12.0%的比例随受过培训的阅读结果漂浮。 如果没有最终的检查,20%的去诺就在同一计算(将一试和两试的预算混合在一起)的完成点和过滤点的0.9分内交付,而40%则落后。 随着最后检查的进行,按照规则以20%的速度中止,在50步模型的对应失败时节省了3.4至6.7%的计算率,在1000步模型的对应失败时节省了4.3至9.9%的计算率,在更严格的目标上则节省了3.4%至6.7%. 训练有素的读取,设定中止同样比例的样本,节省了大约3.6%至10.7%,两者之间没有一致的顺序:读取估计,地层探测,以及两者并存. 在最严格的50个步骤中,使用地层的二人节省较少(4.5%,6.7%至6.8%)。 随机流产无益. 即使是完美的探测器也只能节省6.7至14.9%和11.9%至22.5%。 此上限为封闭式.

blocks.en: Esmati et al. (2026) decode plausibility linearly from the transformer states of video diffusion models, including the 1.3B Wan model ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ) , find the clean VAE latent at chance, and conclude that the diffusion model constructs the signal (Section 2 ). Their transformer probes act on states averaged over all tokens. Their public code does not include the latent baseline, so we reproduce it by averaging the latent in the same way. We encode the IntPhys development set ( Riochet et al., 2021 ) with the Wan 2.1 VAE at the resolution of their IntPhys setting ( 256 × 256 256\times 256 ; 97 frames, giving a latent of 16 channels by 25 frames by 32 × 32 32\times 32 ) and read plausibility with ridge classifiers, keeping the four versions of each scenario on the same side of every split (Appendix F ).
blocks.zh: Esmati等人(2026年)将视频传播模型的变压器状态线性解码,包括1.3B Wan模型(Team Wan等,2025年),偶然发现干净的VAE潜伏,并得出结论,传播模型构造了信号(第2节. 他们的变压器探测器在州内作用 平均在所有的标志上 他们的公用代码不包括潜在基线,所以我们通过同样的方式对潜在基线进行平均再现. 我们在其IntPhys设置的分辨率(256 × 256 256\times 256;97帧,以32 × 32\times 32)将IntPhys开发集(Riochet等,2021年)与Wan 2.1 VAE编码;并用脊分解器读取合理性,将每种情景的四个版本保留在每个分解的同一面(Appendix F.).

blocks.en: The fully averaged latent is at chance, as they report (Table 6 ), and so is every readout that is linear in the latent: keeping the time axis, alone or with a coarse 4 × 4 4\times 4 spatial grid, and adding signed frame-to-frame differences, which are themselves linear in the latent, all stay between 50 and 55% pairwise. One fixed nonlinearity changes this. The absolute frame-to-frame change of the 4 × 4 4\times 4 grid features, read linearly, reaches 77.9% pairwise accuracy on its own, and 79.6% pairwise and 62.1% per-video together with the grid features. That readout scores 79 to 82% pairwise in each of the three IntPhys blocks, and it or the grid’s absolute change alone is the best of the readouts we tried in each (Appendix F lists them all), so choosing it on any one block and testing on the other two gives the same result. It also beats a label-shuffled null (mean 49.9%, 95th percentile 56.7%) in all 1,000 shuffles ( p = 0.001 p=0.001 ), and the signed changes do not ( p = 0.31 p=0.31 pairwise, 0.06 0.06 per video). Without the spatial grid the same transform reaches only 57.4%. The signal is not a global artifact of how the impossible videos are spliced together: the mean frame-to-frame change is only 1.00 to 1.03 times larger in impossible videos at every step, and training-free “largest change” scores, over the whole frame or over any cell of the 4 × 4 4\times 4 grid, are at chance (50.0% pairwise). The readout uses localized changes, consistent with the impossible event itself, an object vanishing, appearing or changing in one region. A small temporal CNN did not train on about 290 training videos.

blocks.en: Impossible events such as a vanishing or teleporting object are mostly changes over time, which an average over all frames largely removes, so chance accuracy of this baseline is no evidence that the latent lacks the signal. The remark does not explain why linear readouts that keep the time axis fail too. The magnitude of change, which they cannot form, is what separates the videos here. Plausibility is therefore not linearly decodable from the clean latent, in agreement with their baseline, but it is present there, and a fixed, training-free transform exposes it. Kinematic statistics of frame-to-frame change likewise detect physics violations in the features of frozen image encoders, where a linear probe on the same features reaches 55.5% on IntPhys 2 ( Internò et al., 2026 ) ; here the same idea applies to a generator’s own VAE latent. By the argument of Section 3.3 , no transformer layer can carry more information about it than this latent together with the text prompt. A transformer that makes the signal linearly decodable has made it more usable, as a good representation should. That alone does not show that the model constructs knowledge absent from its input. Our test does not show that the transformer adds nothing: its per-video accuracy may well exceed our 62% (they report 81.27% per-video for the 1.3B Wan model, averaged over transformer blocks and over the categories of IntPhys and a second benchmark, InfLevel).
blocks.zh: 诸如消失或电传等不可能的事件大多是随时间而变化的,在所有框架上的平均值基本消除了这些变化,因此这一基线的概率准确性并不能证明潜伏者缺乏信号. 这一评论没有解释为什么保持时间轴的线性读取也失败。 变化的程度,它们无法形成, 是这里的视频分离。 因此,在符合其基线的情况下,可视性不能线性地从清洁的潜质中解开,但是它存在,一个固定的、无训练的转变暴露了它。 对帧到帧变化的线性统计同样检测出被冻结的图像编码器特征中的物理学违规现象,在同一种特征上的线性探测器在IntPhys 2(Internò等,2026年)上达到了55.5%;这里同样的想法也适用于生成器自身的VAE潜伏. 根据3.3节的论点,任何变压器层都无法携带比这个潜在层与文本提示层加在一起更多的信息. 使信号可线性解码的变压器使得它更能被使用,因为良好的表示应该. 仅此一项并不能表明该模型在其投入中缺乏知识。 我们的测试没有显示变压器没有增加任何内容:它的每道视频精度可能超过我们的62%(他们报告说1.3B的每道视频为81.27%). Wan型号,平均超过变压器块和IntPhys和第二个基准(InfLevel)的类别.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: In the information sense the claim is always true. A diffusion model computes its clean-sample estimate from its activations and its other inputs, so these hold at least as much as the estimate shows. The claim worth testing is narrower: that the activations hold usable information about the final sample that a readout of the model’s own estimate, equally flexible and equally well tuned, cannot extract. We expected to find such information and found almost none. The layers did look ahead under the standard comparison, and the advantage went away once the estimate was read with the same care, apart from a small gain for floating in the smaller main data sets. What remains is the fall rate of jumps. The layers carry it early in denoising and the estimate shows it only later; on the 50-step model the gain survives every control we applied, and on every model it is small and short-lived.
blocks.zh: 在信息意义上,这一主张始终是真实的。 一个扩散模型从它的活化和其他投入中计算出它的清洁-样本估计值,因此这些估计值至少与估计值所示值相同。 值得测试的说法范围更窄:激活器持有关于最后样本的有用信息,而读出模型自己的估计,同样灵活和同样精细地调制,是无法提取的。 我们期望找到这种信息,但几乎没有发现任何信息。 层层的确在标准比较下向前看,一旦同样小心地阅读了估计,优势就消失了,除了在较小的主要数据集中浮动的少量收益外. 剩下的是跳跃的下降率。 层层在去诺伊化时很早就携带它,估计结果仅显示在后期;在50步模型上,增益活了我们应用的每个控制,在每个模型上都是小而短的.

blocks.en: In practical terms, the floating motions and the balance margins of MDM’s samples are as visible in its own estimate after a fifth of the denoising steps as in its layers. Corrections and filters can act on that estimate directly. How fast a jump falls is the one place where the layers have more to offer, and only early in denoising.
blocks.zh: 实际上,MDM样本的浮动运动和平衡边距在它自己的估计中,在除名步骤的五分之一之后,与分层一样可见。 校正和过滤器可以直接根据这一估计采取行动。 跳出多快是地层可以提供更多东西的地方,而且只是在早起起起去取名.

blocks.en: Our results suggest five checks before concluding that a generator knows more than it shows: 1. Read the model’s own clean-sample estimate at the same step as carefully as the activations: the same readout family, tuned the same way. Report what the layer adds to the estimate, for every layer and with an estimator that can fall back to the estimate alone, and run a positive control on the score the conclusion rests on. Near its ceiling, a pooled AUC can miss a real gain. 2. Score within the groups that share a prompt or a scene, and within prompt and frame where timing is shared, so that recognizing the condition cannot carry the result. Report how the comparison changes with the amount of training data: with a few hundred examples, a high-dimensional probe and a one-number baseline can trade places. 3. Before concluding that a property is absent from the input, try simple fixed transforms of it as well as linear probes. In a video latent where every linear readout is at chance, the magnitude of local frame-to-frame change exposes plausibility. 4. Look at what a target’s variance is made of. A gravity score can mostly measure whether a body floats or falls, which the estimate shows early, instead of how fast it falls, which it shows only later. 5. For early pruning, compare with scoring the decoded preview, and report the saving a perfect detector would give.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,在认定一个发电机比它更了解之前,有五次检查: 1. 读取模型本身的清洁抽样估计,与活化过程相同:读取家族,调取方式相同。 报告每层的估算结果,每层的估算结果,以及可单独回到估算结果的估算结果,并对结论所依赖的分数进行积极的控制。 在天花板附近,集合的AUC可能会错过真正的收益. 2. 在共享一个即时或场景的团体内部,在共享时间的即时和框架内进行评分,以便确认情况不能带来结果。 报告比较与培训数据数量的变化:用几百个例子、高维度探测器和一数基线可以交换位置。 3. 在断定输入中缺少一个属性之前,试用简单的固定变形器以及线性探测器。 在每一次线性读取都可能发生的视频潜伏中,局部帧到帧变化的规模暴露出可信度. 4. 看看目标的差异是什么造成的。 重力分数大多可以衡量一具尸体是浮起还是倒下,而估计显示的是早期,而不是下降的速度,它只是后来才显示. 5. 对于早期的浏览,与解码预览的分数进行比较,并报告保存的完美探测器将会提供的情况。

blocks.en: We study kinematic generators: two transformer diffusion models trained on HumanML3D, MDM at two checkpoints and MotionDiffuse. Models with other training data or designs, such as Kimodo ( Rempe et al., 2026 ) or tokenized generators, may behave differently. Physics-based generators are outside the question, since gravity and contact hold in them by construction and our labels cannot fail. What the kinematic planner of a hybrid represents is a separate question (below). Labels are computed from joints with heuristic thresholds (contact heights, the 15 cm support rule, the 2 m/s 2 floating cut-off). On real motion capture they flag almost no floating and recover the fall rate of real jumps with a spread of about 0.7 to 1.0 m/s 2 (Appendix E ), but we checked one dataset of scripted actions, and the balance margins are probed as continuous quantities rather than failure labels. Our conclusion that the layers add nothing is relative to the readout families we tried, ridge and tuned MLPs on one frame at a time and a small temporal network. A stronger readout could change the comparison. The data-processing argument does not protect this conclusion: it rules out that the estimate holds information the activations and noisy input lack, but allows the reverse, so it is the layer side that a stronger readout could still raise. The fall-rate result comes from jump-heavy runs, and we do not know which computation in the layers carries it, or whether steering along it would change how fast the generated jumps fall. On MDM our probes see only the conditional pass of classifier-free guidance. The early-warning study is simulated from recorded samples. Each decision uses exactly what an online run would see, but retries draw from a finite pool of 12 recorded samples per prompt. The video test reads only the clean VAE latent of the IntPhys development set. It tests the evidence for “absent from the input”, not the transformer’s own advantage, and Esmati et al.’s latent baseline is reconstructed from their description because their public code does not include it. We do not test whether the model causally uses the directions we decode.
blocks.zh: 我们研究动能发电机:两个变压器扩散模型在HumanML3D、两个检查站的MDM和MotionDiffuse接受培训。 具有其他培训数据或设计的模型,如Kimodo(Rempe等,2026年)或象征性的发电机,其行为可能有所不同. 基于物理的发电机在问题之外,因为重力和接触通过构造和我们的标签在它们中是不能失败的。 混合体的动能规划者代表的是一个单独的问题(下方). 标签由带热阈值的关节来计算(接触高度,15cm支持规则,2m/s 2浮动断接). 在真实的动作捕捉中,它们几乎不标出浮起并恢复了真实跳跃的倒下速率,传播范围约为0.7至1.0 m/s 2 (Appendix E.),但我们检查了一个被脚本动作的数据集,平衡边被探测为连续数量而不是失败标签. 我们的结论是,这些层没有增加什么 相对于我们尝试的读取家庭, 脊和调制 MLP一次一个帧和一个小的时间网络。 更强的读出可以改变比较. 数据处理论证并不保护这个结论:它排除了估计持有信息,即激活和吵闹的输入缺失,而是允许倒置,所以更强的读出仍能提升出层侧. 下降率的结果来自于跳跃-重力跑道,我们不知道在地层中哪个计算会携带它,或者沿着它的方向转动是否会改变生成的跳出的速度. 在MDM上,我们的探测器只看到 附加条件的无分层导线 预警研究是从所记录的样本中模拟出来的. 每项决定都使用在线运行所能看到的准确信息,但复试从12个记录样本的有限集合中抽取。 视频测试只读取了IntPhys开发集的清洁VAE潜伏. Esmati等人的潜在基线是从其描述中重建的,因为其公共代码并不包括这一点。 我们不测试模型是否因果使用我们解码的方向.

blocks.en: The natural next test is an on-trajectory replication in a video diffusion model, with a physics label measurable from the generated video (for example the fall rate of a tracked object, a quantity that Kneifl et al. (2026) probe with simulator labels) and the model’s decoded preview as the baseline. The same comparison applies to the kinematic planners inside physics-based hybrids ( Tevet et al., 2024 ) and to models that drive humanoid robots ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , where knowing whether the planner’s own estimate already reveals an imbalance would tell the downstream controller when to intervene.
blocks.zh: 接下来的自然测试是在视频传播模型中进行上电磁复制,从生成的视频中可以测量到物理标签(例如被跟踪物体的倒塌率,克奈弗等(2026年)用模拟器标签进行探测的数量),模型的解码预览作为基线. 同样的比较也适用于物理学混合体内的动能规划者(Tevet等,2024年)和驱动人造机器人的模型(Wang等,2026年),这些模型知道规划者自己的估计是否已经显示出不平衡,会告诉下游控制者何时干预.

blocks.en: We use the official MDM code ( Tevet et al., 2023 ) and its HumanML3D encoder checkpoints with 50 and 1000 diffusion steps. Both have the same architecture and text encoder, but they were trained with different releases of the code, and their saved training settings differ beyond the number of steps (each checkpoint’s args.json ); we therefore treat them as two models, not as a controlled comparison of step counts. Joint positions are recovered from the 263-dimensional HumanML3D features with the dataset’s normalization statistics; no SMPL body model is needed. Each layer’s output is recorded with a forward hook after the condition token is dropped; in the main runs we keep every fourth frame (30 per motion), and the noisy input and the clean-motion estimate are stored at the same frames.
blocks.zh: 我们使用官方的MDM代码(Tevet等,2023年)及其HumanML3D编码器检查站,有50个和1000个扩散步骤. 两者都有相同的架构和文本编码器,但他们都接受了不同版本的代码训练,他们节省下来的训练环境也不同于步数(每个检查站的args.json);因此,我们把它们视为两个模型,而不是对步数的控制比较. 从263维的HumanML3D特征中取回了与数据集的常态统计的联合位置;不需要SMPL机身模型. 每一层的输出在条件令牌被丢弃后用前钩记录;在主跑道中,我们保留每四帧(每起运动为30起),而响亮的输入和清洁运动估计存储在同一帧.

blocks.en: All experiments ran on a single laptop GPU (Apple M4 Pro). A forward pass on the laptop GPU matches the CPU to about 10 − 4 10^{-4} relative error in every layer. Sampling 1,000 motions takes about 2 minutes with the 50-step model and under an hour with the 1000-step model. The SMPL bodies in the figures are fitted to the generated joints for display only, with mean joint errors of 1.0 to 3.0 cm per figure (largest for two of the extreme jumps in Figure 7 c). All probes, controls and simulations run on cached arrays in minutes to an hour. Code that reproduces every experiment, table and figure, from sampling to the final plots, is provided as anonymized supplementary material and will be released publicly with the final version.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都运行在单台笔记本电脑GPU(Apple M4 Pro)上. 笔记本电脑GPU的前传将CPU匹配到每层约10~4 10^{-4}的相对错误. 取出1000个运动用50步模型大约需要2分钟,再取出1000步模型不到1小时. 数字中的SMPL机身被安装在生成的关节上,仅用于显示,平均关节误差为每相图1.0至3.0厘米(图7c中两个极端跳跃的最大). 所有探测器,控制和模拟在缓存阵列上以分数到一小时运行. 复制从取样到最后地块的每一个实验、表和图的代码作为匿名补充材料提供,并将随最后版本公开发布。

blocks.en: For display only, we fit the neutral SMPL body ( Loper et al., 2015 ) to the 22 joints of each drawn frame with the SMPLify-style fitter distributed with MDM ( Bogo et al., 2016 ) (150 iterations). The mean distance between fitted and generated joints is 1.0 to 1.2 cm across the six rows. The lowest mesh vertex lies 1.2 to 6.5 cm below the lowest foot joint, as expected since the ankle and toe joints sit inside the foot, so a floating body’s sole stays visibly above its shadow.
blocks.zh: 仅供展示,我们将中性SMPL机身(Loper等,2015年)与所绘制的每个机框的22个关节相匹配,并配有与MDM(Bogo等,2016年)(150个迭代)所分布的SMPLife-style fitcher. 安装和生成的接头之间的平均相距为一至一至一.2厘米,横跨六行. 最低的网状顶点位于最低的脚关节下方1.2至6.5厘米处,这是自脚踝和脚趾关节坐入脚后所预期的,因此浮起的躯体会明显地停留在它的阴影上.

blocks.en: Per-frame probes predict the final motion’s label at the same frame. Ridge probes use standardized inputs and choose the penalty from { 1 , 10 , 100 , 1000 , 10 4 } \{1,10,100,1000,10^{4}\} by efficient leave-one-out cross-validation. The Estimate, MLP readout concatenates the estimate’s 263 features with the dynamic and static balance margins, lowest-foot height, in-flight and airborne flags and foot sliding speed computed from the estimate (and, for the gravity target, its flight gravity), each with an indicator for undefined values (undefined values set to zero), and its four foot-contact flags. Where the estimate’s own label is undefined, the explicit readout uses the median of its defined values. The MLP (two hidden layers of 256 units, ReLU, dropout 0.1) is trained on standardized inputs and targets with AdamW (learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} , weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} , batch 512) for up to 100 epochs, stopping after 8 epochs without improvement on 15% of the training prompts, held out as a group; the same settings are used for every feature set. Fixed layers: dynamic and static balance, layer 7; flight, layer 6; flight gravity, layer 5.
blocks.zh: 每帧探测器预测最终运动的标签在同一帧. 岭地探测器采用标准化输入,通过高效放出一出式交叉校验,从{1,10,100,1000,10 4}中选择处罚. 估计值中,MLP读取的263个特征与动态和静态平衡边距、最低英尺高、飞行中和空中旗帜以及从估计值(以及重力目标、飞行重力)中计算出脚滑行速度,每个特征都有一个未定义值的指标(未定义值设定为零)及其四个与脚相接触的旗帜。 当估算本身的标签未定义时,清晰读出会使用其定义值的中位数. MLP(两层256个单元的隐藏层,ReLU,辍学0.1)与AdamW(学习率10 - 3 10 - 10 - 3}、体重衰减10 - 4 10 - 10 - 4},第512批)一起接受标准化投入和目标的培训,最多100个世纪,8个世纪之后停止,15%的培训提示作为一个集体进行;每个特点都使用同样的设置。 固定地层:动态与静态平衡 第7地层;飞行 第6地层;飞行重力 第5地层.

blocks.en: To test whether per-frame readouts handicap the estimate on quantities that need several frames, a small temporal network reads all 30 recorded frames of a motion and predicts the final motion’s label at every frame: two 1D convolutions over time (128 channels, kernel 5, the second dilated by 2, GELU, dropout 0.1) and a per-frame linear output, trained with AdamW (learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} , weight decay 10 − 3 10^{-3} , batch 32) on a loss masked to labelled frames, with early stopping (patience 15, up to 200 epochs) on 15% of the training prompts. Inputs are everything the estimate shows, the same fixed layer, or both, at 20% of denoising; folds and scores are those of the per-frame readouts, one seed at a time. blocks.en: Figure 12 shows why the pilot of Section 4.4 pointed the other way, with the linear layer probe of Section 4.2 trained on fewer prompts. The explicit label has a single feature and barely depends on training size (mean R 2 R^{2} 0.780 to 0.783 across sizes). The linear layer probe has 512 features and improves steadily, from 0.553 with 13 training prompts and 0.744 with 52 to 0.798 with 100 and 0.837 to 0.839 with all of them. Applied to the larger data, the pilot’s exact split gives gaps of − 0.003 -0.003 , + 0.022 +0.022 and + 0.049 +0.049 across seeds, so its 12-prompt test set was also too small to fix the sign. Whether the layers appear to know more or less than the model shows can thus be set by the amount of training data, independently of what the model represents.

blocks.en: The unsupported cases are ordinary walking poses with the whole body 7 to 12 cm off the floor (median lowest foot 8.3 cm, median duration 0.6 s) in motions whose lowest foot elsewhere is at the floor (median 2.0 cm): a real floating artifact. A foot-clearance threshold does not separate the groups: requiring the lowest foot to rise above 15 cm keeps 73% of ballistic stretches but also 44% of near-zero ones, because cartwheels and crawling lift the feet. We therefore exclude stretches supported by a knee, wrist or the pelvis, and split the remaining unsupported stretches by whether they fall (Section 3.2 ). Raised feet with no other support still count as airborne; a scene-free label cannot tell a balance beam from floating. All results in the main text use the fixed label. Only gravity-related labels changed; readouts that take the estimate’s airborne flag as an input moved by at most 0.013.

blocks.en: To check the labels where the physics is known, we ran them on the BMLmovi subset of AMASS ( Mahmood et al., 2019 ; Ghorbani et al., 2021 ) : 1,801 motion-capture clips of 86 people performing about 20 scripted everyday actions. Each clip goes through the steps HumanML3D uses to build its training data, so that real and generated motion are labelled in the same form: joint positions from the SMPL+H body model ( Romero et al., 2017 ) with the clip’s gender and the first 10 shape coefficients, downsampling to 20 fps, HumanML3D’s axis convention, retargeting to its uniform skeleton with MDM’s own routine (the retargeted bone lengths match those of a HumanML3D processed clip exactly), and the floor at the lowest joint. The label code is unchanged.
blocks.zh: 为了检查已知物理的标签,我们在AMASS的BMLmovi子集(Mahmood等,2019;Ghorbani等,2021)上运行了这些标签: 1,801个动作-抓取剪辑,共86人进行大约20个脚本的日常动作. 每个剪辑都通过HumanML3D用来构建其训练数据的步骤来进行,这样真实和产生的运动被标记为同一种形式:来自SMPL+H体型(Romero等,2017年)与剪辑的性别以及前10个形状系数的联合位置,样本被降为20英尺,HumanML3D的轴会,用MDM自己的常规重新瞄准其统一的骨架(重定向的骨长与HumanML3D所处理的剪辑完全匹配),底部为最低关节. 标签代码不变.

blocks.en: Real people do not float, and the labels agree. Floating covers 0.09% of frames and occurs in 4 of the 1,801 clips, against 3.8 to 4.7% (50-step) and 8.6 to 9.7% (1000-step) of frames on test captions for MDM; under the threshold settings of Appendix D it stays between 0.07 and 0.27%. A raised foot in contact covers 0.9% of contact frames, against 2.9 to 5.4% for MDM. Of the 302 airborne stretches of at least 0.2 s, 5 (1.7%) are labelled floating.
blocks.zh: 真正的人不会浮出水面 标签也同意 浮动覆盖了0.09%的帧并发生在1,801个剪辑中的4个,而MDM测试标题上的帧比例为3.8%至4.7%(50步)和8.6%至9.7%(1 000步);在附录D的阈值设置下,它停留在0.07%至0.27%之间。 提高的接触脚能覆盖0.9%的接触框,而MDM的接触脚能覆盖2.9%至5.4%。 在至少为0.2秒的302个空中航道中,有5个(1.7%)被贴上浮动标签。

blocks.en: The 297 falling stretches give the noise of the gravity label. At each subject’s own scale their fitted gravity has a median of 9.65 and a standard deviation of 0.77 m/s 2 . HumanML3D’s retargeting, however, scales each subject’s root trajectory by the ratio of leg lengths (median 1.067, range 0.92 to 1.23), and fitted gravity scales with it: in the form MDM is trained on, real jumps fall at a median of 10.33 m/s 2 (standard deviation 1.06). MDM’s jumps, at 9.1 to 9.8 m/s 2 , therefore fall somewhat slower than those of its training data. Taking the frame-weighted spread of real jumps as label noise (0.68 to 0.98 m/s 2 , depending on whether the retargeting spread counts as noise), the fall rate of the jump-heavy runs, with a standard deviation of 2.24 m/s 2 , could be predicted up to R 2 = 0.81 R^{2}=0.81 to 0.91. The readouts of Section 4.3 reach 0.36 to 0.46 on the MDM checkpoints across refits, so the fall rate is hard to predict at 20% of denoising for reasons other than label noise.
blocks.zh: 297个倒地的拉伸使引力标签发出噪音. 在每一主体的自定尺度上,其所装重力的中位数为9.65,标准偏差为0.77米/秒。 然而,HumanML3D的再瞄准,按腿长(中位数为1.067,从0.92到1.23)的比例来测量每个主体的根道并与之相接:在MDM的训练形式下,真正的跳跃以10.33米/秒2的中位数下降(标准偏差为1.06)。 因此,MDM的跳跃速度为9.1至9.8米/秒2,比其培训数据稍慢。 将实际跳跃的帧加权传播作为标签噪声(0.68到0.98 m/s 2,取决于重定向传播是否算作噪声),跳跃-重跑的下行速率,标准偏差为2.24 m/s 2,可以预测为R 2 = 0.81 R^{2}=0.81至0.91. 第4.3节在MDM检查站的读取量超过0.36到0.46,

blocks.en: The IntPhys development set ( Riochet et al., 2021 ) has 360 videos in three blocks (object permanence, shape constancy, spatio-temporal continuity), 30 scenarios per block, each with two possible and two impossible versions. We take the first 97 RGB frames of each video, resize them from 288 × 288 288\times 288 to 256 × 256 256\times 256 with antialiased bilinear interpolation, scale them to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] and encode them with the Wan 2.1 VAE ( Team Wan et al., 2025 ) , keeping the posterior mean. On three videos, encoding on the laptop GPU matched the CPU to 1.4 × 10 − 6 1.4\times 10^{-6} relative error, and decoding reconstructed the frames at 36 to 42 dB PSNR.

blocks.en: Linear readouts are ridge classifiers (targets ± 1 \pm 1 ) on standardized features, solved in the dual, with the penalty chosen from { 10 − 3 , … , 10 3 } \{10^{-3},\dots,10^{3}\} times the feature dimension by 4-fold cross-validation over the training scenarios. The change features | Δ | |\Delta| are the absolute differences between consecutive latent frames of the 4 × 4 4\times 4 grid features (for “time kept + | Δ | |\Delta| ”, of the per-frame spatial means); the signed differences are the same without the absolute value, and therefore a linear function of the grid features. The temporal CNN applies two 1D convolutions (64 channels, kernel 3, ReLU, dropout 0.3) over the 25 latent frames of the grid features and their changes, followed by max- and mean-pooling over time and a linear output; it is trained with AdamW and early stopping on held-out training scenarios, averaged over three initializations. All splits keep a scenario’s four videos together. The label-shuffle null permutes labels within each scenario, which keeps two possible and two impossible videos per scenario, and refits the linear readouts on the shuffled labels, 1,000 times for the three readouts with frame changes (20 times for the others).
